summary: Tested admin trace feature end-to-end. Backend: new pytest suite tests/test_admin_trace.py (16 tests, 14 pass). It checks that every trace row count matches the number shown in overview/funnel(30/90/0)/radar/geo(super+marketing)/business/stats/finance, plus 422/401 errors and RBAC/privacy. Frontend (Playwright, password Super Admin + marketing member mode): every Tableau de bord KPI, funnel step, Géographie row, Analyse métier KPI and row, Activité stat card / LLM numbers / provider chips, and Rentabilité KPIs / AI calls / per-member counts opens trace-dialog with a matching count. Exceptions: r_members and the finance member counts (below). Search, sort, CSV download, Escape close and Enter on KPI cards work. Formula dialogs work for per-member cells, finance warnings, projections and Base commune (knowledge-offers/validations). Marketing: pseudonyms only, no '@', poste/entreprise hidden on r_packs/b_prio_apps (present for super), fin_* 403. Conseiller: b_* 200, m_/f_/r_/g_/a_/fin_ 403. Roles left unchanged (marketing / conseiller).

critical.issue: The count does not match. Finance shows 25 active members, but the trace returns only 8. Cause: finance._members() for the current month counts member_activity users PLUS users with last_seen_at >= start of month. The trace only reads db.member_activity.distinct('user_id', {month}). fin_active_paid has the same bug (active set).

Finance shows paid=10 and active_paid=10 because the month doc has paid_override=10. The trace lists users flagged paid=True, which is 0. The number cannot be traced and no note explains the override. Return a note such as 'Nombre saisi manuellement (override) : 10' when paid_override is set, and compute active_paid the way finance does (min(paid, n_active) when nobody is flagged).

minor.issue: Shows 23 but the trace returns 22. One radar_runs user_id (5207d3e6-c608-46fe-a784-d15a20decfc0) belongs to a deleted user. members() filters on db.users, so the orphan is dropped, while the overview counts distinct run user_ids. Either exclude orphans in the overview or add a 'membre supprimé' row in the trace.
An unknown metric prefix (e.g. metric=zzz) returns 403 instead of 422 for role users: section_of maps it to 'super' before validation. This is only cosmetic.

Possible privacy leak. The member rows include an unmerged 'city' column, which bypasses the MIN_CELL=3 merge used in Géographie: a city with 1 member plus created/last-seen dates could identify someone. No such city exists in the data today (Non renseigné 51, Montréal 3). Suggest masking the city as 'Autres' when its group is smaller than MIN_CELL for non-super roles.

ui_bugs.component: Overview radar Kpi > nested '18 configuré(s)' button
ui_bugs.issue: Pressing Enter on the focused ov-radar-configured button opens 'Radar activé' (r_enabled) instead of 'Radar configuré'. The keydown bubbles to the parent Kpi div, whose onKeyDown calls preventDefault and onClick (r_enabled). Mouse click works (stopPropagation only on click). Fix: add onKeyDown={e=>e.stopPropagation()} on the inner button, or check e.target===e.currentTarget in Kpi.

integration_issues.issue: kpi-active shows 25 but the trace has 8 rows; kpi-paid and per-member-paid show 10 but the trace has 0; per-member-active-paid shows 10 but the trace has 0 (see backend critical issues).
ov-radar-members shows 23 but the trace has 22 (orphan run user).

issues: The StatCard title tooltip still says 'Afficher le détail par jour', but the card now opens the trace of records.
The Date column wraps to 2 lines (e.g. '2026-10-' / '15 14:18'). Add whitespace-nowrap on date cells.

action_items: fin_active/fin_active_paid trace: use the same active set as finance._members (member_activity ∪ users last_seen_at >= month start for the current month)
fin_paid/fin_active_paid: when paid_override is set, return a note explaining the manual number (and/or the flagged list), so the count matches or is explained
r_members: reconcile the orphan radar_runs user_id (exclude it in the overview, or show it as 'membre supprimé' in the trace)
Kpi nested button (ov-radar-configured): stop keydown propagation so Enter opens r_configured
Optional: return 422 for an unknown trace metric even for Bearer roles; mask small-group city in member traces for non-super roles; fix the StatCard tooltip text; nowrap the date column
critical_code_review_comments: admin_trace.trace() is a long if/elif chain (~100 lines). It works, but a dict-based registry would be easier to keep in sync with the insight/finance aggregations, and the count drift found here comes from duplicated filter logic. Suggest reusing the same helper functions (e.g. finance._members) instead of re-implementing the filters.
useTrace: a slow earlier request can overwrite a newer one if the user opens two traces quickly (no request id or abort). This is a minor issue.

success_rate.backend: 87.5% (14/16 tests; failures = r_members and the fin_* count mismatches)
success_rate.frontend: ~92% (all clickable numbers open the dialog; 5 finance counts and 1 radar count mismatch; 1 keyboard bug)
